material_findings.finding: Reject this completed-target proposition. The inspected integrated bird remains visibly different from controlling source: smooth oversized hooked bill, broad bronze hood, sparse regular cheek/optic construction, tall narrow head/neck and continuous breast surfaces differ from the dense weathered layered source. This is a bounded visual judgment, not calibrated proportion measurement. Owner artistic acceptance is explicitly absent. Native preservation and desktop loading cannot discharge either gate.
material_findings.consequence: A development study could be presented as final art or promoted without the required owner decision.

Integrated builder derivesROOTfrom__file__ and passesrootto selected apply/cameraAPIs, so those constants alone do not prove integratedbuild failure. Rebuild on another host, hydratedLFS inputs, Blender5.2.1/dependency equivalence and identical renderpixels were not tested. Builder defaults targetattempt09 and can overwrite frozen outputs if rerun; use a disposable checkout/newoutput for any later authorized rebuild. 61–73MB/642898triangle models were not tested for mobileRAM/loadtime/fps. Semantic era/buttons/focus/live status exist but no keyboard/screenreader/device suite ran.
